instructions.name: activate_strategy
docs: Verify the uploaded bytes against the committed hash, validate the plan
and its accounts, and move the reservation from available to reserved.
Remaining accounts: every plan event in order, then every plan ref in order.

instructions.name: adjudicate
docs: Resolve a dispute with a super-threshold of the same attestor set. Only
chooses the outcome; it cannot move funds.

instructions.name: attest
docs: Submit a threshold attestation. Signatures are verified by Ed25519
precompile instructions in the same transaction; this handler checks
that they cover exactly the domain-separated message, come from
distinct non-revoked keys of the bound set, and carry a fresh nonce.

instructions.name: close_completed
docs: Remaining accounts: plan events in order, then receipt-referenced strategies.

instructions.name: disable_dev_attestors
docs: One-way switch: once development attestors are disabled they can never be
re-enabled for this deployment (production configs start disabled).

instructions.name: execute_action
docs: Permissionless crank. Executes run `run` of action `action` only if the
committed plan allows it right now. Remaining accounts: plan events in
order, receipt-referenced strategies (ascending ref index), then the
action accounts documented in docs/INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md §6.

instructions.name: finalize_event
docs: Persist lazy finality (optional: execution already treats an elapsed challenge window as final).

instructions.name: kill_switch
docs: Kill switch: voids every agent policy of this vault at once. Withdrawals unaffected.

instructions.name: observe_balance
docs: Objective adapter: anyone may submit an observation of the watched token
account. YES the first time balance >= threshold at or before the deadline.

instructions.name: register_mint
docs: Record the vault's canonical token account for an enabled asset (permissionless, idempotent).

instructions.name: set_asset
docs: List or delist an asset. Validates the token program and the Token-2022
extension allowlist; records decimals and the fee treasury account.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Emergency pause of NEW executions only. Withdrawals, cancellations,
releases at expiry and refunds are never paused.

instructions.name: void_disputed
docs: An unadjudicated dispute becomes VOID after the set's timeout.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw uncommitted funds. Owner only (never an agent session key);
never blocked by the emergency pause.

fields.name: treasury
docs: fee destination token account for this mint

fields.name: revoked
docs: bitmap over key indices

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration. The admin can list assets / routes / attestor sets
and pause NEW executions. The admin has no instruction that moves vault
funds, edits plans, or blocks withdrawals, cancellations or refunds.

fields.name: token_account
docs: canonical ATA(vault, mint, token_program)

types.name: OutcomeEvent
docs: Canonical outcome registry entry. Its address commits to the adapter, the
venue market id, the rule version and the resolver binding.

fields.name: binding
docs: attestor set (attestation) or watched token account (balance)

fields.name: creator
docs: signer that created the plan (owner or an agent session key)

fields.name: policy
docs: policy account when created by a session key, default otherwise
